recognize_zh: 低倍肝臟切片可見肝小葉架構保存，但竇狀隙呈網狀被深染單核細胞浸潤撐開，上方門脈區也有浸潤；這種瀰漫竇狀隙加門脈區浸潤的低倍型態是白血病（此例 JMML）侵犯肝臟的線索。
features: Preserved lobular architecture with intact hepatocyte plates
Diffuse sinusoidal infiltrate of small-to-medium hyperchromatic cells forming a lace-like network
Periportal/portal tract infiltrate at the top of the field
No mass-forming or nodular destructive lesion
Hepatocytes with focal microvesicular clearing; no significant necrosis
describe_en: Low-power H&E section of liver shows preserved lobular architecture with a diffuse infiltrate of hyperchromatic mononuclear cells expanding the sinusoids in a lace-like pattern and involving a portal tract at the top of the field. There is no mass-forming or destructive lesion, and hepatocytes are intact with focal cytoplasmic clearing. Individual cell lineages cannot be resolved at this power. The combined sinusoidal and portal pattern is consistent with hepatic involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia, to be confirmed on high-power and immunohistochemical evaluation.

ddx.vs: Also sinusoidal, but on high power shows megakaryocytes and erythroid islands without monocytic predominance.
Purely sinusoidal infiltrate of monotonous CD3+ γδ T cells with sparing of portal tracts.
Portal inflammation is lymphoplasmacytic with interface activity and spotty necrosis, not a diffuse sinusoidal hematopoietic infiltrate.
